question.text: What information services do RTAs and ISCs provide to mutual fund investors?

answer.text: RTAs are not involved in information services; that is solely the AMC's responsibility
RTAs/ISCs provide KIM, forms, account statements, and information on offers, IDCW payouts, maturity dates, and awareness content for UPI handles and SEBI Check
RTAs offer certified financial planning courses to investors
RTAs conduct mandatory investor awareness workshops every quarter

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the NISM Series II-B workbook (pp.62, 179), RTAs and Investor Service Centres (ISCs) provide KIM, application forms, account statements, information about offers, IDCW payouts and maturity dates, and specific awareness content on UPI handles and SEBI Check. These are the source-backed RTA / ISC information services. The Trap: RTAs are not educational institutions — they don't run formal courses or quarterly workshops. The broader claim that they generally drive investor education or AMC-driven awareness initiatives is not supported by the checked II-B pages. Note: Keep the answer narrow: KIM / forms / account statements / offer & IDCW / maturity-date information plus UPI-handle and SEBI Check awareness content.
